sections.title: Memories of a "Friend"
notes: Needed: Combat gear, some food, ivandis flail or blisterwood flail, Saw, one dose of anti-venom or two doses of antipoison
Recommended: Ectophial for fast access to Port Phasmatys, Drakan's medallion, Super energy or Stamina potions

steps.text: Talk to the Mysterious Stranger by the entrance to the Theatre of Blood.
No Theatre of Blood raids completed:
Completed at least 1 Theatre of Blood raid:
chat: 1. Speaking of your associates, what's all this really about?

steps.text: Go down the stairs to the north-east of the Mysterious Stranger. Bring a saw and blisterwood flail.
Kill a vyrewatch for a key.
Unlock the gate to the south and open the coffin.
Return to the Mysterious Stranger with Ranis' head and watch the cutscene.
Go to the dungeon (cave) north of Darkmeyer (south of Port Phasmatys).
Follow the path north, then east to the egg sac.
Search the nearby skeleton.
Read the sticky note.
Speak to Daer Krand in the Sisterhood Sanctuary to obtain sulphuric acid.
The entrance is located south of the graveyard in Slepe.
To reach Daer Krand, make your way toward the centre of the sanctuary, then follow the path east, then north. He is located upstairs.
Return to the dungeon (cave) north of Darkmeyer.
Use sulphuric acid on the egg sac. You do not need to kill any spiders.
The spiders here can envenom you. Drink a dose of anti-venom or two doses of anti-poison to cure it.
Return to the Mysterious Stranger with the strange spider eggs. Watch two cutscenes.
chat: 1. I found some of those eggs.

sections.title: In Touch with Nature
notes: Needed: Ghostspeak amulet or Morytania legs 2+, any axe, equipment and food to kill a level 302 hespori
Recommended: Dramen staff for fast travel to the Grotto, Super combat potion, Antipoison, Drakan's medallion, Druid pouch or a lit Fire of Dehumidification to protect food from ghasts

steps.text: With ghostspeak amulet or Morytania legs 2+ (and druid pouch to protect food), go to the Nature Grotto (fairy ring BIP), and speak to the Nature Spirit Filliman Tarlock inside the grotto.
Go to the island on the east side of Mort Myre (directly east of the grotto, just west of Castle Drakan).
Look for the island north of the Shades of Mort'ton minigame symbol.
Cross the stepping stone and kill the hespori and chop it afterwards to obtain hespori bark.
Return to the Mysterious Stranger. Watch two cutscenes.

sections.title: Theatre of Blood
notes: Needed: High-level combat gear of all styles, a method to inflict poison, food, potions, etc. to do a Theatre of Blood raid if never completed one, optionally more party members if you have trouble alone
Note: If you have completed the Theatre of Blood before (any mode), you will be given the option to skip this section.

steps.text: Complete a Theatre of Blood raid (any mode works, although entry mode is recommended). See this page for details on mechanics of the bosses.
Talk to the Mysterious Stranger again after completing the raid. Watch two cutscenes.
Congratulations, quest complete!
